assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target: the approved Design 2 study with antique-white lobed middle panel. Image 2 is Design 1, REFERENCE ONLY for its prominent gold band around the ornamental middle. Make a careful refinement of image 1. (1) Enclose the ENTIRE antique-white middle panel in a clear, continuous, substantial antique-gold accent band, following its exact present lobed silhouette. Use warm ochre-gold, a brighter gold inner and outer hairline, and restrained tiny bead accents like the reference. The band should have roughly the visual weight of Design 1's middle-panel gold bar, about 8–12 pixels wide at this 1060px card width, not a faint single thin line. Carry this gold band all the way around the top lotus cap, both shoulders, both broad side lobes, lower shoulders and bottom lotus cap with no missing runs. Preserve the panel shape and antique-white fill. (2) Fix all incomplete color coverage at the inner and outer border, especially near the bottom, lower corners and bottom panel tip. The dark interior fill must meet the gold inner rectangular frame completely, with no leftover ivory slivers, unpainted strips, light gaps or short stops. The outer colored frame must likewise be continuously colored to its gold outlines. Only the intentional outside paper margin and the ornamental middle panel are antique white. (3) This is the Prussian Blue variant: outer border #1A5375, surrounding interior field a darker version of that SAME hue #10354B. Preserve all five circular floral medallions, their teal grounds, red/ivory flowers, jade leaves and vines, small gold floral sprigs, all positions and scale, outer border's gold lotus vine linework, centered composition, opposing half-turn design, full card 5:7 crop, and paper margin. Do not import Design 1's floral artwork, change any medallion to a diamond, or recolor the cream middle panel. One flat single card back, no text or mockup. Keep ornament legible and crisp.
